verification_type: VERIFIED BY SOFTWARE INTEGRATION TEST & FORMAL PROTOCOL AUDIT

cases.trigger_point: Domain action executed, system killed before SQLite outbox transaction commits
cases.state_at_recovery: Database rolled back via SQLite atomic commit rules. No partial event or outbox record exists.
cases.recovery_mechanism: Caller/Agent runtime restarts cleanly; re-evaluates or re-executes task from last checkpoint.

cases.case: Case 2: Crash after Outbox Commit, before Relay Send
cases.trigger_point: Event and outbox record committed (status='pending'); process terminated before HTTP POST /push
cases.state_at_recovery: Event and pending outbox record durable on disk in SQLite.
cases.recovery_mechanism: On startup, SyncEngine.process_outbox() scans pending records and dispatches to relay.
cases.guarantee: Zero event loss. At-least-once delivery guaranteed.

cases.case: Case 3: Crash after Relay Send, before ACK Received
cases.trigger_point: HTTP POST sent; Relay processes batch; client dies before writing ACK/status='delivered' to local DB
cases.state_at_recovery: Outbox record remains status='pending' locally, but Relay already holds the events.
cases.recovery_mechanism: On restart, client retransmits batch. Relay inbox detects known event IDs and deduplicates idempotently. Relay returns HTTP 200 with ACK. Client updates status='delivered'.
cases.guarantee: Idempotent receiver prevents duplication. Sender safely completes ACK.

cases.case: Case 4: Crash inside Relay during Batch Ingestion
cases.trigger_point: Relay receives batch, writes 50% of events to DB, crash occurs before commit
cases.state_at_recovery: Relay SQLite transaction aborted; partial batch discarded.
cases.recovery_mechanism: Sender encounters connection drop / HTTP 500 / timeout. Sender retries batch with exponential backoff.
cases.guarantee: Relay consistency maintained. No torn writes.

cases.case: Case 5: Crash after Inbox Write, before Domain Projection
cases.trigger_point: Relay or Target Node appends event to inbox table; crashes before projecting to tool/experience registry
cases.state_at_recovery: Inbox table holds status='pending' or unprocessed sequence entries.
cases.recovery_mechanism: Target node recovers inbox; replay/projection worker processes pending inbox records into domain tables.

cases.trigger_point: Tool invocation recorded as EXECUTING; process dies before report completion
cases.recovery_mechanism: Durable ledger detects uncompleted invocation on restart. If re-invoked with same tool_call_id, returns previous outcome or handles idempotent abort.
cases.guarantee: Zero duplicate side effects on external system or device.

cases.case: Case 7: Crash during Large Backlog Sync
cases.trigger_point: Syncing 1,000 events; process killed at event 450
cases.state_at_recovery: Cursor committed up to event 400 (last successful batch).
cases.recovery_mechanism: On restart, pull_events(after_sequence=400) resumes from event 401. Inbox deduplicates any overlapping records.
cases.guarantee: Strict monotonic resumption without full re-sync.
